title: The drift detector runs todo items' checks without an isolated query log home
goal: Found in the SP-owbgisoj review: bl_intake's drift detector (backlog.py intake --file --hook, every SessionStart) runs todo items' checks with its own environment, not bl_base.run_check's isolated query log home (ST-3p74zj4k), so their tests.py test.run rows and any ql_capture write reach the clone's spool, against kb/_self/backlog.md's rule that no check adds a row there. The detector runs its checks with bl_base.check_env and a temporary home, as run_check does.

run: import pathlib,sys;t=pathlib.Path("_tools/bl_intake.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8");ok="bl_base.check_env" in t or "check_env(" in t and "tempfile" in t;print("drift runs checks with an isolated home:",ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

repro_reason: the defect shows only as rows a SessionStart hook run leaves in the clone spool; the repro reads whether the detector uses the isolated environment

run: import pathlib,sys;t=pathlib.Path("_tools/bl_intake.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8");ok="bl_base.check_env" in t or "check_env(" in t and "tempfile" in t;print("drift runs checks with an isolated home:",ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
